title: auth.membership.created payload
description:
Payload for `auth.membership.created`, published by Auth when a user is attached to an organisation. Emitted in both cases the invitation flow can take: a brand-new account, and an existing account added to a further organisation (where no credential link is issued at all). A consumer must therefore not treat this event as implying the user is new.

The file name is the routing key — that is how `SchemaDiscovery` keys the catalog.

user_id.description: Platform-wide user identity, as a string.

roles.description: Role names on this membership at the moment it was created. Roles are per membership, not per user (ADR-0016), so this list is scoped to `org_id` and says nothing about the same user elsewhere. It is a snapshot: later changes come as their own events.
